items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex gains 200 pts, Nifty tops 24,100; Nifty Metal rises over 1%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Tuesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap fell 0.96 per cent while the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.06 per cent

items.title: Milky Mist zooms 9.5% as Q1 profit surges multi-fold, up 65% over IPO price
items.description: Milk Mist, which listed on the bourses on August 18 after a solid response to its initial public offering (IPO), trades 65 per cent above its offer price of ₹140 based on today's intraday high.

items.title: NBFCs enter durable recovery phase; MOFSL backs L&T Finance, PNB Housing
items.description: MOFSL said that NBFC asset quality has emerged as the biggest positive surprise, with improved collections and moderated fresh slippages after nearly two years of stress.

items.title: Symbiotec Pharmalab makes tepid market debut, lists at par with IPO price
items.description: The listing of Symbiotec Pharmalab was well below GMP expectations, which had indicated a listing gain of around 18-19 per cent for IPO investors.

items.title: Skyways Air Services shares defy GMP expectations, list at 10% discount
items.description: Skyways Air Services' shares debuted at ₹124 apiece on the National Stock Exchange, a 10.14 per cent discount to the initial public offer (IPO) price of ₹138 apiece.

items.title: India's stock auction needs market makers as price swings persist
items.description: The NSE auction absorbed a record $4.2 billion in MSCI-linked trades, but sharp price swings persisted, highlighting concerns over thin liquidity and the lack of market makers

items.title: Hy-Tech Engineers makes strong debut, lists at 42% premium on NSE
items.description: Hy-Tech Engineers shares listed at ₹72 on the BSE, a premium of 35.85 per cent against the offer price of ₹53. Meanwhile, on the National Stock Exchange, it debuted at ₹75, up 41.51 per cent.

items.title: ITC rallies 5%; Happiest Minds Technologies slips 5%; here's why
items.description: ITC Infotech will acquire an aggregate minority stake of 22.1% in Happiest Minds from the Promoter and Promoter entities for a total consideration of ₹1,330 crore (average price of ₹395/share).

items.title: Nifty August range second-narrowest in 3 years; here's what history shows
items.description: On average, Nifty's monthly trading band expanded to nearly 6%, and up to 12% in the following four months after a range contraction, according to NSE's 3-year monthly data.

items.description: Stocks to buy today: Anand James of Geojit Investments has shared a bullish outlook on three stocks: Jubilant Ingrevia, ASK Automotive, and KPR Mill.

items.title: Stocks to watch: ITC, Happiest Minds, ICICI Bank, PVR Inox, Cipla & more
items.description: PVR Inox approved a buyback of up to 20,68,965 fully paid-up equity shares at ₹1,450 per share, for an aggregate amount of up to ₹300 crore.

items.title: CAMS, Kalpataru Projects: 2 stocks on Kotak Securities' radar for near term
items.description: Shrikant Chouhan of Kotak Securities has shared a bullish view on two stocks - CAMS Ltd and Kalpataru Projects International.
